name: @waf-harness/goal
description: Goal mode: a stop hook that keeps the session working toward an objective — re-injecting it every round and checking the goal file — until the goal is complete, blocked, or out of token budget.

wafh.short_description: Loop the session on an objective until it is done.

quick_start.prompt: Write fizzbuzz.py in this Workspace that prints FizzBuzz for 1 to 30, run it, and check that every line of the output is right.

wafh.title: Goal Mode
